goal: Is ke baad aap star aur number patterns (triangle, inverted triangle, pyramid, diamond, hollow square) print kar sakte hain, rows ke liye ek outer loop aur spaces aur stars ke liye inner loops use kar ke, aur aap tasveer dekh kar loop ka formula nikaal sakte hain.
warmup: Cricket stadium ko upar se dekhein, ya class room ki seats ko: rows aur columns. Ek row left se right ki ek line hoti hai, aur har row mein kuch seats hoti hain. Room bharne ke liye aap row ba row chalte hain, aur har row mein seat ba seat. Pattern print karna bhi yehi chalna hai. Outer loop row chunta hai. Inner loop us row ke saath chalta hai aur har seat ke liye ek symbol print karta hai. Jab row khatam ho jaye to aap Enter (endl) dabate hain taake agli row par chale jayein.
definition: Pattern printing ka matlab hai ek loop ke andar doosra loop (nested loops) use kar ke characters se ek shape banana. Outer loop ROWS ginta hai. Inner loop COLUMNS ginta hai: us row ke stars, numbers ya spaces. Inner loop outer loop ke har ek round ke liye shuru se aakhir tak poora chalta hai. Inner loop khatam hone ke baad cout << endl; row ko khatam kar deta hai.
howItWorks: Raaz ek chhoti si table mein hai. Koi bhi code likhne se pehle pattern banayein aur har row number i ke liye likhein ke us mein kitni spaces aur kitne stars hain. Phir i ka (aur n ka, rows ki tadad ka) formula dhoondhein. Right triangle: row i mein i stars hote hain. Inverted triangle: wahi, bas rows n se 1 tak neeche jati hain. n = 4 ke saath pyramid: row 1 mein 3 spaces aur 1 star, row 2 mein 2 spaces aur 3 stars, row 3 mein 1 space aur 5 stars, row 4 mein 0 spaces aur 7 stars. Yaani spaces = n - i aur stars = 2 * i - 1. In mein se har formula ek inner loop ki end value ban jata hai. Ek row ke andar tarteeb hamesha yeh hoti hai: pehle spaces, phir stars, phir endl. Diamond ek pyramid (rows 1 se n) aur uske baad ulta pyramid (rows n - 1 se neeche 1 tak) hota hai. Hollow square sirf border par star print karta hai (pehli ya aakhri row, pehla ya aakhri column) aur baaki har jagah space.
